scientific_question: Is the E03B bottom-first construction blocked primarily by instantaneous lower-boundary extraction rate, or by cumulative state displacement, and can a gentler bottom-first transfer yield an equal-total-water, equal-root30 but deeper-distribution-separated origin pair?
derivation: E03B established a strong direction asymmetry: every full-rate BOTTOM_THEN_TOP family failed at bottom phase step 7.
The next discriminator changes only transfer rate and compensating phase length, while keeping complete-family integrated top and bottom transfer equal.
No state threshold or response threshold is changed.

forcing_order.complete_family_mass: same rate magnitude and same number of bottom-only and top-only intervals, so integrated top transfer equals integrated bottom transfer exactly

baseline: one strict BASE_EQ interval with q_top=q_bottom=q_eq
execution_contract: every family starts from the same fresh B01 Se=0.85 origin
every non-baseline family first executes exactly 10 strict CLOSED intervals
only families completing CLOSED, BOTTOM and TOP phases contribute endpoints
one strict Reference physical advance per interval; no automatic temporal subdivision
no fallback, retry, tolerance relaxation or direct physical-state mutation
failed intervals terminate the family and preserve the latest committed state bit-identically
only family/rate/step/time and committed H/theta are emitted for selection

response_blind_selection.candidate_set: BASE_EQ plus all completed gentle BOTTOM_THEN_TOP endpoints
response_blind_selection.no_match: Close E03C NO_MATCH without extending the rate grid, phase grid, timestep or thresholds.

rate_discriminator.primary_diagnostic: completion/failure boundary by rate fraction and cumulative bottom-only transfer
interpretation: If a lower rate survives materially greater cumulative bottom-only transfer than full-rate E03B, rate sensitivity is supported.
If failure occurs at approximately the same cumulative removed water despite lower rate, cumulative state displacement is the more likely limiter.
This diagnostic is about construction admissibility, not production solver robustness.

next_if_selected: GC-RZM06E04 preregisters common-time reconstruction of the immutable E03C selected pair and an identical forcing-free fixed-Hc response probe with W_profile and W_root30 gates enforced.
controls: retain all E03/E03B state thresholds unchanged
nonclaims: E03C is not a production solver stress test
E03C selection alone does not establish deeper-profile response memory
no second MODFLOW hydraulic state is introduced
